prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Cold-pressed seed oils show variable tocopherol content between cultivars, with measured values reaching 68 mg/100 g oil as a key natural antioxidant system.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-01692","field":"abstract","quote":"Tocopherol content measured by HPLC-FLD varied significantly between cultivars (p < 0.01), with NS-H3 yielding the highest γ-tocopherol (68 mg/100 g oil)."}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Peroxide value development during shelf-life can be modelled using accelerated testing methods with kinetic modelling to identify oxidation parameters.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-01696","field":"keywords","quote":"Accelerated shelf-life testing of hemp seed oil microcapsules: kinetic modelling of peroxide value"}]},{"claim":3,"text":"Lipid oxidation in seed oils proceeds through primary oxidation with peroxide formation, and pH is an environmental factor affecting oxidation during storage.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-01700","field":"abstract","quote":"pH-driven wall matrix swelling and lipid oxidation during 28-day refrigerated storage"}]}]}
